reply_text:
Let me open the Adweek Q4 call piece and the Q2 2014 transcript.I found two candidates for 2014. Neither is in Zuckerberg's own published words: I read both only in news reports, so each is marked `coverage_only`.

- **The strong one (22 Oct 2014, Tsinghua University Q&A in Beijing).** He said that 10 years from then, computers would be better than humans at reading, listening and talking. He spoke mostly in Chinese. The quote is Quartz's English translation, which VentureBeat reprinted. The phrase "artificial intelligence" was said in English. I could not open the Quartz article, the original recording or a transcript, so the wording is a translation.
- **The weak one (29 Jan 2014, Q4 2013 earnings call).** Adweek printed a short excerpt in which he says the new AI research group fits into a strategy over "maybe five- or 10-year period." It looks forward and names a span, but it describes where AI fits in Facebook's plans more than what AI will achieve. Adweek's article is paywalled after that excerpt. HuffPost reported, only in its own words, that he expected Facebook's AI work to reshape the experience about five years out. That paraphrase can't be quoted.

What I checked and left out:
- **Q2 2014 earnings call (23 Jul).** He said "over the next few years" AI work would add value for users. "Next few years" counts as undated and isn't about AGI, so it stays out.
- **Q3 2014 earnings call (28 Oct).** The page I opened showed only the first of 20 pages, with no AI forecast in it.
- **First public town hall (6 Nov).** The write-up I opened had no AI answer in it.

I didn't find any 2014 statement about when AGI or superintelligence will arrive. I used 9 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings.
